heading: INT. NIGHT FERRY - TABLE-TENNIS CABIN - NIGHT

units.text: INT. NIGHT FERRY - TABLE-TENNIS CABIN - NIGHT
The floor tilts a few degrees with every swell.
A green table is bolted to the deck, its net held up by two bungee cords.
Rain ticks on the portholes.
Fluorescent tubes buzz overhead.
AKIKO SATO (19, wiry, a towel around her neck she never uses) stands at one end, bouncing the ball against her paddle without looking at it.
Across from her, RUSLAN BEKOV (34, heavy shoulders, a fisherman's sweater) rolls the ball between his palms like a stone he is deciding whether to throw.
Behind Akiko, her coach MAEVE DONNELLY (60s, windbreaker zipped to the chin) folds and refolds a score sheet into smaller and smaller squares.
LEOPOLD HUBER (70s, umpire's armband over a cardigan) sits on a stool by the table and does not take his eyes off the ball.

NADIA FARAH (11, in a school blazer) sits cross-legged on the floor with a juice box, and BIG ED VANCE (50s, vendor's apron, ferry crest on the pocket) leans in the doorway with a tray of cold coffees that nobody has asked for.
Ten all.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Ruslan serves.
Akiko returns low.
The ball rides the ship's lean and dies at the corner.
Ruslan lets it go.
He sets his paddle down on the table, picks it up again, and wipes it on his sleeve.
Maeve's square of paper becomes a smaller square.
Nadia's straw makes a long dry sound in the empty box.
Ten, eleven. Bekov leads.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Akiko doesn't blink.
She walks to the towel she left on the bench, touches it with two fingers, and walks back without picking it up.
You've done this before.
units.name: MAEVE

units.text: Not on a boat.
units.name: AKIKO

units.text: Big Ed sets a coffee on the edge of the table.
Leopold slides it off without looking.
Ruslan serves.
Akiko lunges, the ship lurches, and her paddle skids out of her hand and clatters under the bench.
Nadia picks it up and holds it out with both hands, as if returning a hat at a funeral.
It's still warm.
units.name: NADIA

units.text: Akiko takes it.
She looks at the little girl a moment longer than she needs to.
Then she turns and serves, short, flat, and the ball hops twice before Ruslan can lift his wrist.
Leopold half rises from the stool.
Maeve's paper tears.
Eleven all.
units.name: LEOPOLD

units.text: Ruslan nods once, slowly, to nobody.
He holds out his hand across the net.
Akiko stares at it.
Take the handshake, kid. It's the only dry thing on this boat.
units.name: BIG ED

units.text: Akiko takes it.
